hint: Here $4$ is being taken away from $x$. Which operation puts it back?

hints.text: Here $4$ is being taken away from $x$. Which operation puts it back?
Add $4$ to both sides so the subtraction is undone. The right side becomes $9 + 4$.
$9 + 4 = 13$, so the solution of the equation is $x = 13$.

explanation: In $x - 4 = 9$, the number $4$ is subtracted from $x$.
Addition undoes subtraction, so add $4$ to both sides of the equation.
The left side becomes $x$ and the right side becomes $9 + 4 = 13$.
Check: $13 - 4 = 9$ is true, so the solution is $x = 13$.
